Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The new expectation matches the recorded golden file. The file contains 8 Rapid, 4 Plunge, 12 Feed and 22 Arc records. These records give 46 moves. The CLI counts the arcs as feed moves, which gives 34 feed moves.

Local results against upstream/main at d3e779907018a9483902c6edc286cf9472712e3d:
- The trial merge passed. The PR already contains this main commit.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-cl --no-run -j 4`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-cl --test headless_bin -j 4`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-cl --all-targets -j 4 -- -D warnings`: passed.

Requested changes: none.

This PR changes one test expectation. It does not change G-code, geometry, safety checks, stock simulation or golden files. No mutation tests apply. No UI changes require screenshots. I did not run the full batch tier.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
